description.zh:
指定返回的图像形式。

- 如果不设置，则返回四通道PNG图。
- 如果设置为`mask`，则返回单通道mask。
- 如果设置为`whiteBK`，则返回白底图。
description.en:
The format of the returned image.

- If this parameter is not set, a four-channel PNG image is returned.
- If this parameter is set to `mask`, a single-channel mask is returned.
- If this parameter is set to `whiteBK`, an image with a white background is returned.

descriptions.zh:
## 功能描述
食品分割能力用于对图片中的食品进行像素级抠图，并返回抠图结果。

> - 您可以进入[在线咨询](https://www.aliyun.com/core/online-consult?from=aZgW6LJHr2)获取在线人工帮助。
- 当前能力可在视觉智能开放平台有完整的免费产品体验，您可以单击[立即试用](https://vision.aliyun.com/experience/detail?&tagName=imageseg&children=SegmentFood)对该能力进行更直观试用以及在线购买。
- 阿里云视觉智能开放平台视觉AI能力API接入、接口使用或问题咨询等，请通过钉钉群（23109592）加入阿里云视觉智能开放平台咨询群联系我们。

## 应用场景
- 餐厅菜单：拍摄实物菜品后，通过食品分割，即可将菜品从杂乱背景中抠出，添加到菜单中。
- 美食广告：在餐饮业推广宣传中，将美食照片抠图后再加工处理成广告素材。

## 特色优势
适应范围广：适合大部分中西式菜品、面包、蛋糕点心等自动抠图。

## 接入指引
1. 注册阿里云账号：打开[阿里云官网](https://www.aliyun.com)，在阿里云官网右上角，单击**立即注册**，按照操作提示完成账号注册。
2. 开通能力：请确保您已开通[分割抠图服务](https://vision.aliyun.com/imageseg)，若未开通服务请[立即开通](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=viapi_imageseg_public_cn#/open)。
3. 创建AccessKey：请确保您已[创建AccessKey](~~175144~~)，如果您使用的是子账号AccessKey，您需要给子账号赋予AliyunVIAPIFullAccess权限，具体操作，请参见[RAM授权](~~145025~~)。
4. 在线调试（可选）：您可以通过[OpenAPI Explorer](https://next.api.aliyun.com/api/imageseg/2019-12-30/SegmentFood?spm=a2c4g.171485.0.i3)在线调试能力，查看完整的调用示例代码及SDK依赖信息，也可以下载完整的工程。
5. 开发接入步骤：
- 在[SDK总览](~~145033~~)中选择您要接入使用的SDK语言。
- 在对应语言的SDK文档中找到AI类目为分割抠图（imageseg）的SDK包进行安装。
- 参考文档中提供的示例代码进行适当修改后调用。

6. 客户端直接调用：该能力常用的客户端调用方式包括以下几种。
- [Web前端直接调用](~~467779~~)
- [小程序场景下直接调用](~~467780~~)
- [Android端直接调用](~~467781~~)
- [iOS端直接调用](~~467782~~)

## 输入限制
- 图像格式：PNG、JPEG、JPG、BMP。
- 图像大小：不超过4 MB。
- 图像分辨率：大于40×40像素，小于1999×1999像素。
- URL地址中不能包含中文字符。

## 计费说明
关于食品分割的计费方式及报价，请参见[计费介绍](~~190132~~)。

> 下方调试接口为付费接口，如需免费体验调试请前往[体验中心](https://vision.aliyun.com/experience/detail?&tagName=imageseg&children=SegmentFood)。

## Feature description
The food segmentation feature performs pixel-level segmentation on food items in images and returns the segmentation results.

> - You can join [online consultation](https://www.aliyun.com/core/online-consult?from=aZgW6LJHr2) to get help from our support team.
- You can try this feature for free on the China site (Chinese). Click [China site (Chinese)](https://vision.aliyun.com/experience/detail?&tagName=imageseg&children=SegmentFood) to try this feature or purchase it online.
- To get help with Visual Intelligence API integration, usage, or other questions, join the DingTalk group (23109592).

## Common scenarios
- Restaurant menus: After photographing dishes, use food segmentation to extract the dishes from cluttered backgrounds and add them to menus.
- Food advertising: In food industry promotions, extract food photos and process them into advertising materials.

## Advantages
Wide adaptability: Supports automatic segmentation for most Chinese and Western dishes, bread, cakes, pastries, and more.

## Getting started
1. Create an Alibaba Cloud account: Go to the [Alibaba Cloud official website](https://www.aliyun.com), click **China site (Chinese)** in the upper-right corner, and follow the instructions to create an account.
2. Activate the feature: Make sure that you have activated the [Image Segmentation service](https://vision.aliyun.com/imageseg). If you have not activated the service, [activate it now](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=viapi_imageseg_public_cn#/open).
3. Create an AccessKey pair: Make sure that you have [created an AccessKey pair](~~175144~~). If you are using a RAM user AccessKey, grant the AliyunVIAPIFullAccess permission to the RAM user. For more information, see [RAM authorization](~~145025~~).
4. Online debugging (optional): You can use [OpenAPI Explorer](https://next.api.aliyun.com/api/imageseg/2019-12-30/SegmentFood?spm=a2c4g.171485.0.i3) to debug this feature online, view complete sample code and SDK dependency information, or download the complete project.
5. Development and integration steps:
- Select the SDK language you want to use from the [SDK overview](~~145033~~).
- Find the SDK package for the Image Segmentation (imageseg) category in the corresponding SDK documentation and install it.
- Modify the sample code provided in the references as needed and invoke it.

6. Direct client calls: Common client call methods for this feature include the following.
- [Direct call from web frontend](~~467779~~)
- [Direct call from a mini program](~~467780~~)
- [Direct call from Android](~~467781~~)
- [Direct call from iOS](~~467782~~).

## Input limits
- Image format: PNG, JPEG, JPG, or BMP.
- Image size: up to 4 MB.
- Image resolution: greater than 40 × 40 pixels and less than 1999 × 1999 pixels.
- The URL cannot contain Chinese characters.

## Billing description
For information about the billable methods and pricing of food segmentation, see [Billing overview](~~190132~~).

> The debugging API below is a paid API. To try it for free, go to the [China site (Chinese)](https://vision.aliyun.com/experience/detail?&tagName=imageseg&children=SegmentFood).
